defaults.contactWelcome: Send your message and it will be delivered to the bot owner.
defaults.supportWelcome: This is a channel support list.

botCreation.selectType: Choose the type of bot to create:
botCreation.sendToken: Send the bot token now. Your message will be deleted immediately after it is read.
botCreation.invalidFormat: The token format is invalid. Send a valid token or cancel.
botCreation.invalidToken: Telegram rejected this token. Check it and send it again.
botCreation.alreadyRegistered: This bot is already registered in Octobot.
botCreation.failed: The bot could not be created now. Please try again later.

contact.deliveryFailed: Your message could not be delivered now. Please try again later.
contact.replyRequired: To answer a visitor, reply to their forwarded message or to the sender-ID message posted by the bot after it.
contact.replyFailed: Your reply could not be sent to the visitor. Delivery was not confirmed.
contact.disabled: The owner has temporarily stopped this bot.

contactOwner.title: Manage @{{username}}
contactOwner.sendWelcome: Send the new {{language}} welcome message. It must be text no longer than 3500 characters.
contactOwner.invalidWelcome: Send valid text no longer than 3500 characters.
contactOwner.noLinkedChannels: No channels are currently linked to this bot.
contactOwner.deactivateLinkWarning: This will stop this bot's services in “{{title}}” only. The channel and other bots are unaffected.
contactOwner.removeLinkWarning: “{{title}}” will be removed from this bot's list and only this bot's services will stop there. It can be linked again later.

channelLink.autoInstructions:
Forward a published channel message now, or send the channel's complete username, link, or numeric ID. You must be a channel administrator or owner, and the bot must be an administrator with post and delete permissions.

If the bot is not an administrator yet, use the button below to add it. It can also detect the addition and link the channel automatically.
channelLink.selectBot: Choose the bot you added as a channel administrator:
channelLink.noBots: You have no active bot. Create one first, then add it as a channel administrator.
channelLink.sendReference: Directly forward a published message from the channel, or send only its username (such as @channel), t.me/channel link, or complete numeric channel ID. You must be a channel administrator or owner, and this bot must be an administrator with post and delete permissions.
channelLink.notFound: The channel could not be found. Check the username or forward a message from it.
channelLink.administratorRequired: You must be a channel administrator or owner to add it.
channelLink.botAdminRequired: Add the selected bot as a channel administrator, then try again.
channelLink.requiredPermissions: The bot needs at least permission to post and delete messages.
channelLink.success: Channel “{{title}}” was linked to the bot successfully.
channelLink.failed: The channel could not be linked now. Please try again later.
channelLink.removed: Services from this bot stopped for the channel because the bot was removed or is no longer an administrator. Start the channel-link flow again in this bot to restore them.
channelLink.permissionsLost: Services from this bot stopped for the channel because it lost permission to post or delete messages. Fix the permissions, then link the channel again from this bot.
channelLink.invitePermissionDisabled: The channel was disabled because the bot cannot create invite links. Grant that permission and service will resume automatically.
channelLink.invitePermissionRestored: Invite-link permission was restored, so channel services were reactivated automatically.
channelLink.relinkRequired: The bot permissions are available, but the previous link is inactive. Link the channel manually from this bot to restore services.

management.contactDeactivateWarning: This will temporarily deactivate @{{username}}. Contact delivery and channel services will stop, and visitors will be told that the owner stopped the bot. Its {{count}} channel links and settings will remain saved, and their services will return on activation after Telegram permissions are verified.
management.contactDeleteWarning: @{{username}} will disappear from your account and its commands, messages, and channel services will stop. History remains, and the bot will not be removed as a Telegram channel administrator. To add it again, submit its token from the beginning and re-link its channels.
management.supportDeactivateWarning: This will temporarily deactivate @{{username}}. Commands and new publishing stop. Channels and the schedule stay saved. Deletion of posts already sent continues on time.
management.supportDeleteWarning: @{{username}} will disappear from your account and publishing will stop. History remains, and the bot stays a Telegram channel administrator. Adding it again requires its token.
management.channelDeactivateWarning: Deactivating “{{title}}” will stop new platform services through {{count}} active links, including future publishing, ads, and earnings that depend on the channel. Previous records and earnings are unaffected.
management.channelInactiveLinksWarning: “{{title}}” currently has no valid active links. Deactivation will prevent any new service from running until you activate it again.
management.channelDeleteWarning: “{{title}}” will disappear from your account and all of its services and links will stop. Bots will remain Telegram channel administrators, and historical records will remain. To use it again, add it and verify every required bot link from the beginning.
management.botActivated: The bot was activated. Services resumed for saved links that still have the required Telegram permissions.
management.botDeactivated: The bot was temporarily deactivated. Channel links and settings remain saved.
management.botDeleted: The bot was removed from your account while its history was retained.
management.channelDeleted: The channel was removed from your account while its history was retained.
management.notFound: The item was not found or is no longer available to your account.
management.invitePermissionRequired: Activation failed: grant the bot permission to create invite links.
management.telegramUnavailable: Telegram is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
management.actionFailed: The action could not be completed now. Please try again.

supportList.contactMissing: The owner has not set a contact link yet.
supportList.contactHint: You can create your own contact bot from the main bot and put it here.
supportList.addInstructions: Add the bot as an admin, or forward a post, or send the channel id. You must be allowed to add admins, and the bot needs post and delete rights. Adding the bot does not skip review.
supportList.sendListName: Send the list name, for example Education. Up to 64 characters.
supportList.invalidListName: Send a name of 1 to 64 characters.
supportList.viewRetry: The channel could not be opened. Try again.
supportList.sendContact: Send a contact link: t.me, tg://, or @username.
supportList.invalidContact: That link is not usable. Use t.me, tg://, or @username.
supportList.confirmDelete: Remove “{{title}}” from the list? It leaves publishing and frees its slot. An internal record remains. The bot stays in the channel.
supportList.deleted: The channel was removed from the list.
supportList.permissionsShort: The bot still lacks required permissions.
supportList.inviteShort: This private channel needs invite-link permission.
supportList.unavailable: Telegram could not be reached. Disable flags were not changed.
supportList.invalidReason: Send a reason of 1 to 200 characters.
supportList.duplicate: This channel is already in the list or has an open request.
supportList.listFull: The list is full (30 channels). The request was not accepted.
supportList.promoterRequired: You must own the channel or be an admin who can add admins.
supportList.adminDeletedNotice: The manager removed “{{title}}” from the list.
supportList.permissionsLostNotice: “{{title}}” stopped because post or delete permission was lost.
supportList.permissionsRestoredNotice: Bot permissions returned in “{{title}}”. Any other disable reason still applies.
supportList.inviteLostNotice: “{{title}}” stopped because an invite link could not be created.
supportList.inviteRestoredNotice: A link for “{{title}}” is available again. Any other disable reason still applies.
supportList.previewUnfit: The list does not fit in one message. An incomplete list was not published.
supportList.previewEmpty: No channels are eligible for preview.
supportList.sendTimes: Send up to 4 times as HH:mm, for example 09:30, 21:00
supportList.sendRetention: Send how many minutes the post stays (15 to 2820).
supportList.invalidTimes: Could not read the times. Send one to four HH:mm values.
supportList.overlap: Those times are closer than the keep duration, the 30-minute send-delay allowance, and the 10-minute retry margin.
supportList.retentionLimit: Duration must be from 15 minutes up to 47 hours.
supportList.sendTimeZone: Send an IANA time zone, for example Asia/Riyadh.
supportList.invalidTimeZone: That time zone name is unknown.
supportList.reasonParticipant: The participant disabled it. Activate to clear this reason.
supportList.reasonAdmin: The manager disabled it: {{reason}}. The participant cannot clear this.
supportList.reasonPermissions: The bot lost post or delete rights. Restore them, then tap Activate.
supportList.reasonInvite: Private channel without invite permission. Restoring it clears only this reason.
supportList.publishUnfit: “{{listName}}” was not published because it does not fit in one message. No partial list was sent.
supportList.unconfirmedHome: {{count}} destination(s) have an unconfirmed delivery. They were not sent again. Check those channels. A copy without a stored message id cannot be deleted automatically.
supportList.unconfirmedDelivery: Delivery of “{{listName}}” to “{{channel}}” is unconfirmed. It was not sent again, because Telegram may already have the post. Check the channel. This copy cannot be deleted automatically without a stored message id.
supportList.notAllowed: Only the owner can do this.
supportList.defaultSlots: Default schedule: two publish times are chosen each day, and the list stays for 3 hours.
supportList.customSlots: Each row is the publish time, how long it stays, and delete.
supportList.customSlotsEmpty: There are no custom times. Custom publishing waits until you add one or restore the default.
supportList.sendOneTime: Send the publish time as HH:mm, for example 09:30.
supportList.confirmDeleteSlot: Delete {{time}}? Its future run is cancelled. Posts already sent keep their original delete time.
supportList.confirmResetSlots: Replace the custom times with the default schedule? Two variable times each day, kept for 3 hours. Posts already sent are still deleted on their original time.
supportList.confirmResetSettings: Reset list settings except the list name? Acceptance becomes automatic, the format becomes buttons, the time zone returns to UTC, publishing turns on, and the schedule returns to the default with a 3 hour stay. The contact link is cleared. Channels, requests, records, and delete jobs for posts already sent stay.

errors.privateOnly: Use this bot in a private chat.
errors.generic: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
